note: whole-unit (composite) translations; ⟦n⟧ sequence must match the English exactly

items.en: ⟦0⟧ can be assigned to task forces to govern their behavior. Each mission has a corresponding ⟦1⟧.
items.zh: 可以给特遣舰队指派⟦0⟧，以决定它们的行为。每个任务都有对应的⟦1⟧。

items.en: Although missions can be assigned at the task force level, the operating area for the mission is defined at the fleet level by ⟦0⟧.
items.zh: 虽然任务是在特遣舰队一级指派的，但任务的活动区域是在舰队一级通过⟦0⟧来确定的。

items.en: When task force(s) are performing a mission in their fleet's assigned regions, an icon will be visible in the center of each of these ⟦0⟧. The icon represents the mission being performed. Below the icon is a number, which represents the number of task forces performing the mission in this region. If the cursor is placed over this number, a tooltip will appear which provides further information about the mission.
items.zh: 当特遣舰队在其舰队所分配的区域中执行任务时，这些⟦0⟧的中央都会显示一个图标。该图标表示正在执行的任务。图标下方有一个数字，表示在此区域执行该任务的特遣舰队数量。将光标移到这个数字上，就会出现一个提示框，提供关于该任务的更多信息。

items.en: A task force assigned to the ⟦0⟧ mission will perform exercises in the region adjacent to the nearest port. ⟦1⟧ will continually be gained while ships are performing this mission.
items.zh: 被指派执行⟦0⟧任务的特遣舰队，会在最接近的港口相邻区域进行演习。舰船执行此任务期间会持续获得⟦1⟧。

items.en: Consume ⟦0⟧ at 60%⟦1⟧ of their normal rate of fuel consumption.
items.zh: 消耗⟦0⟧，为其正常燃料消耗速率的 60%⟦1⟧。

items.en: Provide a small amount of ⟦0⟧ each day.
items.zh: 每天提供少量⟦0⟧。

items.en: A task force assigned to the ⟦0⟧ mission will search for enemy ships. A single task force can only patrol a single strategic region at once, so multiple task forces are required to patrol multiple regions.
items.zh: 被指派执行⟦0⟧任务的特遣舰队会搜寻敌方舰船。一支特遣舰队一次只能巡逻一个战略地区，因此巡逻多个地区需要多支特遣舰队。

items.en: When enemy ship(s) have been found, the patrolling task force will gradually gather information about the enemy force. This process is called ⟦0⟧, and its progress is measured as a percentage which is visible in a tooltip. When the enemy force is 100% spotted, it becomes possible to engage them in battle.
items.zh: 发现敌方舰船后，执行巡逻的特遣舰队会逐步收集有关敌方舰队的情报。这一过程称为⟦0⟧，其进度以百分比表示，可在提示框中查看。当敌方舰队被 100% 发现时，就可以与其交战。

items.en: The spotting progress starts at ⟦0⟧ and increases by ⟦1⟧ until it reaches 100%. If the hourly change would be zero or negative, the task force can't spot that enemy. The patrol can only start spotting enemy submarine forces with a probability of:⟦2⟧
items.zh: 发现进度从⟦0⟧开始，并按⟦1⟧递增，直到达到 100%。如果每小时变化为零或负值，特遣舰队就无法发现该敌人。巡逻只能以如下概率开始发现敌方潜艇部队：⟦2⟧

items.en: After an enemy force is fully spotted, the patrolling task force may choose to engage the enemy immediately, depending upon their assigned 交战规则. Any ⟦0⟧ assigned to the region (regardless of their parent fleet) may also choose to leave port and engage the enemy, depending upon their own engagement rules.
items.zh: 在敌方舰队被完全发现后，执行巡逻的特遣舰队可以立即选择与敌交战，这取决于其被指派的交战规则。被指派到该区域的任何⟦0⟧（无论其母舰队是哪一支）也可以根据自身的交战规则选择离港与敌交战。

items.en: A task force assigned to the ⟦0⟧ mission can automatically intercept and engage enemy forces within their fleet's assigned regions, ⟦1⟧ an enemy force has been fully spotted by a ⟦2⟧ task force belonging to the same country. The strike force does not need to be in the same fleet as the patrolling task force in order for this coordination to occur.
items.zh: 被指派执行⟦0⟧任务的特遣舰队，可以在其舰队所分配的区域内自动拦截并攻击敌方舰队——⟦1⟧同一国家的⟦2⟧特遣舰队完全发现敌方舰队之后。这种协同并不要求打击舰队与巡逻特遣舰队同属一支舰队。

items.en: When not intercepting enemy forces, a strike force will remain in port to conserve ⟦0⟧.
items.zh: 不拦截敌方舰队时，打击舰队会留在港内以节省⟦0⟧。

items.en: A strike force will only choose to intercept and engage a spotted enemy force if their ⟦0⟧ permits it. An engagement rule of 'Never engage' would cause a strike force to remain in port indefinitely, while an engagement rule of 'Always engage' would allow a strike force to intercept and engage an enemy force regardless of its strength.
items.zh: 只有在⟦0⟧允许的情况下，打击舰队才会选择拦截并攻击已被发现的敌方舰队。交战规则设为「从不交战」会使打击舰队一直留在港内，而设为「始终交战」则允许打击舰队不计敌方实力地拦截并攻击。

items.en: A task force assigned to the ⟦0⟧ mission will protect 运输船队 belonging to the player or their allies if they are attacked. This protection is extended to all of the fleet's assigned regions, although the number of regions that can be efficiently protected depends upon the number and size of task forces performing the mission within a given fleet. Along with other important information, this maximum number of regions is visible when the cursor is hovered over the convoy escort mission icon in the center of any region where the mission is taking place.
items.zh: 被指派执行⟦0⟧任务的特遣舰队会保护属于玩家或其盟友的运输船队，使其在遭受攻击时得到保护。这种保护会扩展到该舰队所分配的所有区域，不过能够被有效保护的区域数量取决于在某一舰队内执行该任务的特遣舰队的数量与规模。除其他重要信息外，当光标悬停在任何正在执行该任务的区域中央的运输船队护航任务图标上时，就会显示这一最大区域数量。

items.en: When the ⟦0⟧ is selected, existing convoy routes are shown on the map. This can be useful for determining which strategic regions require convoy escort coverage.
items.zh: 选中⟦0⟧后，地图上会显示现有的运输船队航线。这对于判断哪些战略地区需要运输船队护航覆盖很有帮助。

items.en: It is worth noting that troop transfers across water are performed using convoys, and can be protected through this mission like any other convoy. However, when troop transfers are being performed automatically as part of a 海军登陆 order, the ⟦0⟧ mission may be a more appropriate choice.
items.zh: 值得注意的是，跨海部队运输是使用运输船队执行的，可以像保护其他运输船队一样通过此任务加以保护。不过，当部队运输作为海军登陆命令的一部分自动执行时，⟦0⟧任务可能是更合适的选择。

items.en: ⟦0⟧ is an important metric in relation to convoy escort missions. When escort efficiency is 100% among task forces within a given fleet, one of these task forces will instantly come to the defense of any convoys under attack within the fleet's assigned regions. If escort efficiency falls below 100%, some or all of the defending ships will arrive late to the battle when friendly convoys are attacked, increasing the likelihood of convoys being destroyed by the attackers.
items.zh: ⟦0⟧是运输船队护航任务的一项重要指标。当某支舰队内特遣舰队的护航效率为 100% 时，其中一支特遣舰队会立即前往保卫该舰队所分配区域内任何遭受攻击的运输船队。如果护航效率低于 100%，当友方运输船队遭到攻击时，部分或全部防御舰船会迟一步抵达战场，从而提高运输船队被攻击方击沉的可能性。

items.en: Ships with minelaying equipment can be assigned to ⟦0⟧ missions during wartime. They will continue adding mines to each assigned strategic region until 1000⟦1⟧ mines have been laid in each region, at which point the regions are considered to be fully saturated with mines.
items.zh: 装备布雷设备的舰船在战时可以被指派执行⟦0⟧任务。它们会持续向每个被指派的战略地区布设水雷，直到每个区域布下 1000⟦1⟧枚水雷，此时这些区域被视为已完全布满水雷。

items.en: Bonus (⟦0⟧) to naval supremacy for the owner of the mines.
items.zh: 水雷所有者获得的制海权加成（⟦0⟧）。

items.en: Increased chance of ⟦0⟧ up to ⟦1⟧.⟦2⟧ Naval accidents from mines can do far more damage than from other types of accidents.
items.zh: ⟦0⟧发生概率提高，最高 ⟦1⟧。⟦2⟧ 水雷造成的海军事故，其破坏程度远超其他类型的事故。

items.en: Decreased speed up to ⟦0⟧⟦1⟧ as mines no longer affect ship speed
items.zh: 航速降低最高 ⟦0⟧⟦1⟧，因为水雷不再影响舰船航速

items.en: Invasion penalty up to ⟦0⟧⟦1⟧
items.zh: 登陆惩罚最高 ⟦0⟧⟦1⟧

items.en: When equipped with ⟦0⟧, destroyers can be assigned to ⟦1⟧ missions during wartime. These ships will continue removing mines from their assigned strategic regions until they are fully clear of mines.
items.zh: 装备⟦0⟧后，驱逐舰在战时可以被指派执行⟦1⟧任务。这些舰船会持续清除其被指派战略地区中的水雷，直到该区域的水雷被完全清除。

items.en: Task forces assigned to the ⟦0⟧ mission will escort convoys which are ferrying friendly troops to perform a ⟦1⟧. Once these convoys have arrived at their destination safely, the assigned task forces will hold position adjacent to the landing site to provide support via ⟦2⟧ as long as a battle is taking place. If there's no battle or the battle is over, those task forces will return to their home port.
items.zh: 被指派执行⟦0⟧任务的特遣舰队会护航运送友方部队执行⟦1⟧的运输船队。待这些运输船队安全抵达目的地后，只要战斗仍在进行，被指派的特遣舰队就会在登陆点相邻位置待命，通过⟦2⟧提供支援。若没有战斗或战斗已结束，这些特遣舰队将返回母港。

items.en: Task forces can be ordered to ⟦0⟧ in two different ways:
items.zh: 可以通过两种不同方式命令特遣舰队⟦0⟧：

items.en: ⟦0⟧ cancels the current mission and moves the task force to the closest friendly port.
items.zh: ⟦0⟧会取消当前任务，并将特遣舰队调往最近的友方港口。

items.en: Clicking the hold button while holding down ⟦0⟧ cancels the current mission and makes the task force stay in its current province. A task force on hold doesn't consume fuel. When positioned on a sea province, it can block connections (visible as broken red lines across the water) between land provinces, to prevent enemy land units from moving between them.
items.zh: 按住⟦0⟧的同时点击待命按钮，会取消当前任务并让特遣舰队停留在当前省份。处于待命状态的特遣舰队不消耗燃料。当它位于海上省份时，可以阻断陆地省份之间的连接（显示为水面上断裂的红线），以阻止敌方陆军单位在它们之间移动。

items.en: If surface ships are on hold in a province adjacent to a land battle involving enemy divisions, the ships will automatically perform ⟦0⟧ to reduce the enemy's attack and defense.
items.zh: 如果水面舰船在敌方师参与陆战的相邻省份待命，这些舰船会自动执行⟦0⟧，以降低敌方的攻击与防御。

items.en: The magnitude of this effect is determined by the firepower of the ships involved: each point of heavy gun damage contributes ⟦0⟧ to enemy attack and defense, while each point of light gun damage contributes ⟦1⟧. Total reduction from shore bombardment is capped at ⟦2⟧. Naval shore bombardment can also critically hit, causing severe damage to forts and coastal forts during combat.
items.zh: 此效果的强弱取决于参与舰船的火力：每 1 点重炮伤害会对敌方攻击与防御贡献⟦0⟧，而每 1 点轻炮伤害则贡献⟦1⟧。岸轰带来的总降低幅度上限为⟦2⟧。海军岸轰也可能造成致命一击，在战斗中重创要塞与海岸要塞。

items.en: The ⟦0⟧ 将领 trait and the ⟦1⟧ 海军上将 trait increase shore bombardment, but not beyond the -33% cap.
items.zh: ⟦0⟧将领特质与⟦1⟧海军上将特质会提高岸轰效果，但不会超过 -33% 的上限。
